testCases.name: CVS-A10 — View requests without a valid token are refused with no data
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 11)

steps.desc: View requests without a valid token are refused with no data
steps.note: Request 1 (no Authorization header) -> 401 TOKEN_MISSING 'Authorization token is required.', no data (ok); a malformed bearer -> 401 TOKEN_INVALID (ok). Request 2 (expired token): a fresh login token (JWT iat 15:14:38Z, exp 15:19:38Z = 5 min), never refreshed, was sent at 15:22:55Z (server Date header; server and local clocks agree within 1 s) -> 200 OK with the full Leads view list, 197 s after its exp. After POST /iam/auth/logout the same token -> 401 SESSION_REVOKED. So access-token expiry is not enforced; only session revocation stops a token. One clean observation: two other probe tokens were revoked by the account's 5-session cap (shared with a parallel run) before they could be checked (both answered 401 SESSION_REVOKED, not an expiry code).

testCases.name: CVS-A11 — A request without x-tenant-id never returns another tenant's data
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 12)

steps.desc: A request without x-tenant-id never returns another tenant's data
steps.note: With bearer + x-tenant-id: 200, 96 Leads list views. Without x-tenant-id: 200, the identical 96 views (same ids). Recorded behaviour: the header is not required - the tenant comes from the token. Extra: a different tenant id (…0003) and a non-UUID value in x-tenant-id were also ignored and returned the same NDC-Staging views; no request returned another tenant's data.

testCases.name: CVS-B14 — The ?view= URL opens permitted views and falls back safely for others
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 28)

steps.desc: The ?view= URL opens permitted views and falls back safely for others
steps.note: Shared/foreign views were made by ALT1 (creator profile does not matter here). Own 'QA CV x' -> opens, tab selected. 'QA CV shared-to-me' (ALT1, shared with OWNER) -> opens, 9 records. Deleted 'QA CV gone' and ALT1's private 'QA CV user-private' (both API 404 for OWNER) -> ?view= is stripped, a toast says 'That view is no longer available. Showing your default view.', nothing of the view is shown, no console errors, no failed API calls. FAIL: the fallback is not All Leads - both land on 'QA CV tab2' and lastListViewId is rewritten to it (it was 'QA CV shared-to-me' a moment before), so the 'default view' is neither All Leads nor the last view used. Zoho for an unknown view id shows 'This action cannot be performed. The view you are trying to access is not available. Go To All Leads'. Extra finding (seen in D08): a full page load of ?view=<id> for a view on a non-default layout (FieldPermissions) is also dropped - the app loads the Standard layout and ignores the view, even though the view exists; in-app navigation to the same URL works. openListViewIds still holds 3 deleted ids (as in B03).

testCases.name: CVS-C21 — Read-only view keys cannot be changed through the API
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 51)

steps.desc: Read-only view keys cannot be changed through the API

testCases.name: CVS-C22 — Wrong value types in a create request are rejected cleanly
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 52)

steps.desc: Wrong value types in a create request are rejected cleanly
steps.note: name 12345 / ['QA CV arr'] / {x:1} -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; name null -> 422; columns 'name' / {a:1} -> 422; criteria 'status=1' / [] / 7 -> 422; page_size '25' / [25] / {n:25} -> 422 (also 0 and 500 -> 422). No 500 anywhere, no partial view. Two nulls in the test data are valid per the contract and were accepted as 'not set': columns:null -> 201, stored as [] (= 'No columns chosen'); page_size:null -> 201 (contract: page_size|null). Suggest removing those two values from the case. Observation: 422 bodies only say 'The view is not valid.' with no field detail.

testCases.name: CVS-D01 — Each field type offers exactly the operators listed in spec §2.3, with none missing and none extra
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 55)

steps.desc: Each field type offers exactly the operators listed in spec §2.3, with none missing and none extra
steps.note: Operator lists read in the editor for 21 fields (Leads Standard: Company, Lead Status, Owner, Source, Tags, Review Status, Created At, Lead Source; Leads FieldPermissions: Date, Date Time, Checkbox, Multi Select, Lookup, Pick List, Number, Currency Permission; Deals: Amount, Stage, Pipeline, Closing date, Account) and in the Filter panel for the same fields - every list is identical (same operators, same order). Against spec §2.3: Text (Company) = the 8 listed; Number/Currency/Amount = equals, not_equal_to, greater_than, less_than, >=, <=, is_empty, is_not_empty (no between); Date = the listed set incl. last/next_n_days, age_in_days, due_in_days, before/after_now; Datetime = date set + last_n_hours/next_n_hours; Checkbox = is_true/is_false; Picklist/Status/Owner/Source/Review status = equals, not_equal_to, contains_any_of, contains_none_of, is_empty; Multi-select/Tags = contains_any/all/none_of, is_empty; Lookup/Pipeline/Account = equals, not_equal_to, is_empty. Nothing from §2.3 is missing. Only difference: date, datetime, picklist, multi-select and lookup also offer 'Is not empty' (and the empty id is is_empty, not 'empty'), which §2.3 does not list - Zoho has both, so this is treated as a spec update, not a defect. Amount never offers contains (cf. D19 API gap).

testCases.name: CVS-D02 — Text operators split records correctly for odd input, follow the module filter's case rule, and treat SQL-like input as a literal
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 56)

steps.desc: Text operators split records correctly for odd input, follow the module filter's case rule, and treat SQL-like input as a literal
steps.note: Seeds (Standard layout): L01 'QA CV Acme', L02 'qa cv acme', L03 'شركة الأمل', L04 'QA CV Rocket 🚀', L05 'QA​CV Zero', L06 empty (other QA CV leads empty). Rules recorded: matching is case-insensitive (D3 starts_with 'Q' -> L01,L02,L04,L05; D7 equals 'QA CV ACME' -> L01,L02); leading/trailing spaces are trimmed at match time but stored as typed (D6 equals -> L01,L02); D8 contains 'الأمل' -> L03 only; D10 ends_with '🚀' -> L04 only; D12 is a literal (equals/contains/starts/ends -> 0, not_equal_to/does_not_contain -> all 16, no error); D14 contains/starts_with 'QA​CV' -> L05 only, not L01 (zero-width kept). not_equal_to/does_not_contain include records with an empty Company (same in the module filter). testCases.name: CVS-D05 — Odd numeric input is normalised or rejected with a message and is never stored as 15
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 59)

steps.desc: Odd numeric input is normalised or rejected with a message and is never stored as 15

'١٥٠٠٠' and 'abc' -> box stays empty, Save shows 'Complete this row (field, operator and value) or remove it.' (ok, blocked with a message). '-1' -> D06 (ok). testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 62)

steps.note: FieldPermissions seeds (Date Time Permission, stored UTC, shown by the app in Cairo UTC+3): R01 = 3 Oct 23:50, R02 = 4 Oct 00:10, R03 = 4 Oct 23:50, R04 = 5 Oct 00:10 Cairo. Grid (records?view_id) == module filter at every check. 19:10 Cairo 4 Oct: today -> R03,R04 (expected R02,R03); yesterday -> R01,R02 (expected R01); tomorrow -> none (expected R04); the grid shows R04 as '05/10/2026 12:10 AM' inside the Today view. 23:50 Cairo 4 Oct: same (today R03,R04; yesterday R01,R02; tomorrow none). 00:10 Cairo 5 Oct: same again - expected today R04, yesterday R02,R03, tomorrow none; the results did not move at Cairo midnight because the UTC date was still 4 Oct. testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 63)

testCases.name: CVS-D16 — Lookup equals, not_equal_to and empty return the correctly linked records
testCases.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (row 70)

steps.desc: Lookup equals, not_equal_to and empty return the correctly linked records
steps.note: Seeds (FieldPermissions): R01 -> Contact X 'lead01', R02 -> X, R03 -> Contact Y 'lead02', R04-R10 empty. Editor: Lookup Permission offers Equals / Not equal to / Is empty / Is not empty, but the value control for Equals is a plain text box ('Value'), with no record search or picker and no suggestions while typing. Typing the record name 'lead01' saves value 'lead01' literally and the view shows 0 records (R01/R02 are linked to lead01). defects.title: API accepts expired access tokens (JWT exp not enforced) as long as the session is alive
steps: Sign in via POST /api/v1/iam/auth/login (x-tenant-id header) and keep the access_token; do not refresh it
Wait until the token's exp claim has passed (token lifetime is 5 min)
Call GET /api/v1/modules/{Leads}/views?kind=list with that bearer
defects.expected: 401 for an expired token, no data
defects.actual: 200 OK with the full view list 197 s after exp (server clock checked via Date header); only logout/revocation makes the token fail (401 SESSION_REVOKED)

defects.title: today / yesterday / tomorrow criteria cut days at UTC midnight instead of the tenant's Cairo time
steps: Set Date Time Permission on 4 FieldPermissions leads to 3 Oct 23:50, 4 Oct 00:10, 4 Oct 23:50 and 5 Oct 00:10 Cairo time
Create a view: Name starts with 'QA CV' + Date Time Permission = Today
Open it on 4 Oct (any time after 03:00 Cairo); repeat with Yesterday and Tomorrow
defects.expected: Today -> the 00:10 and 23:50 records of 4 Oct; Yesterday -> 3 Oct 23:50; Tomorrow -> 5 Oct 00:10 (Cairo dates, as the app displays them)
defects.actual: Today -> 4 Oct 23:50 and 5 Oct 00:10 (the app itself shows the latter as 05/10/2026 12:10 AM); Yesterday -> 3 Oct 23:50 and 4 Oct 00:10; Tomorrow -> none. Same in the Filter panel. See report for the 23:50/00:10 runs

defects.title: Lookup criterion value is a plain text box - no record picker, so 'equals <record>' cannot be built in the UI
steps: Leads > New custom view on the FieldPermissions layout
Add criterion Lookup Permission > Equals
Try to choose a contact (e.g. 'lead01') as the value; save
defects.expected: A searchable list of the lookup module's records (as in Zoho); the view returns the leads linked to the chosen record
defects.actual: Only a free-text box ('Value'), no suggestions; the typed name is stored literally and the view returns 0 records. Works only if the record UUID is pasted (server logic is correct)

defects.title: Number criteria accept non-numeric values ('1e9' in the editor; 'abc', '15,000', Arabic digits via API) and silently match nothing
steps: Deals > New custom view, Amount equals, type '1e9', Save
Open the view
API: POST /modules/{Deals}/views with amount equals 'abc'
defects.expected: '1e9' read as 1000000000 or rejected with a message; API 400/422 for 'abc'
defects.actual: Editor saves the string '1e9' -> 0 records; API returns 201 for 'abc', '15,000', '١٥٠٠٠', '1e9' and stores the raw strings (0 matches). Zoho's amount box only accepts digits

defects.title: API stores a criteria operator that is invalid for the field type (contains on a currency field)
steps: POST /api/v1/modules/{Deals}/views with criteria [{field:'amount',operator:'contains',value:'1'}] and pattern null
GET /modules/{Deals}/records?view_id=<new view>
defects.actual: 201 Created; the view applies a text match on Amount (29 of 51 deals for '1'). Unknown fields/operators are correctly rejected with 422

defects.title: Grid appends unchosen Tags and Source columns to a view with a chosen column list; Manage Columns says 8 while 10 are shown
steps: Leads > New custom view, choose 8 columns and order them
Save and open the view
Open Manage columns
defects.expected: Exactly the 8 chosen columns, in order
defects.actual: 8 columns in the right order + Tags + Source appended; Manage Columns shows 'VISIBLE (8)'; Tags/Source cannot be chosen or removed in the editor

defects.title: Empty or spaces-only view name: Save is silently disabled, 'Enter a name for the view.' is never shown
steps: Leads > New custom view
Leave the name empty or type 3 spaces, tab out
Look at the form and the Save button
defects.expected: The message 'Enter a name for the view.' (Zoho: 'Custom view name cannot be empty.')
defects.actual: No message anywhere; Save just turns disabled

defects.title: ?view= with a deleted or foreign view id falls back to an arbitrary view ('QA CV tab2') instead of All Leads and overwrites the last-used view
steps: As OWNER open /modules/{Leads}?view=<deleted view id> (or another user's private view id)
defects.expected: Fall back to All Leads (Zoho: 'The view you are trying to access is not available. Go To All Leads')
defects.actual: Toast 'That view is no longer available. Showing your default view.' then 'QA CV tab2' opens and lastListViewId is rewritten to it

defects.title: Deep link ?view= to a view of a non-default layout is dropped on a full page load
steps: Create a view on the Leads FieldPermissions layout
Open /modules/{Leads}?view=<that id> in a new tab (full load), or reload while on it
defects.expected: The FieldPermissions layout and the view open
defects.actual: The Standard layout opens and ?view= is discarded; the view is only reachable by in-app navigation
